questions.stem_text:

from:

options.A: socialization into working class families and communities
options.C: issue-based concerns about culture and lifestyle

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - socialization into working class families and communities

questions.stem_text: Stone's research suggests that prior to industrialization, the nuclear family:

options.A: did not exist in any form
options.B: had begun to disappear, as extended networks of kin became more important

options.D: was simply another institution of patriarchal control

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - had begun to emerge through the separation of work and home life
